Carrefour to Buy Codifrance in $171 Million Deal
Carrefour said that is has agreed to buy Codifrance from Colruyt Group in a deal that values the food distribution company at 152 million euros, including debt, equivalent to $170.9 million.
The French supermarket group said Monday that the deal will help grow its convenience retail offering. For the 2026 fiscal year, Codifrance generated 307 million euros in sales.
Carrefour expects to close the transaction in the first half of 2027.
